name: WIRING CONNECTORS HARNESS
text:
Infrared sauna wiring harness and connectors is a system of connections through wires and cables that is used to power the electrical parts of the infrared sauna. It includes everything that transmits signals and current from one spot to another.

It is better when wires are organised in order, when they are bonded together for easier maintenance and reconfiguration. It is useful to have well maintained cables and wiring when upgrading or repairings.

Lacing, straps, sleeves and electrical tape all can be combined to make the working system last longer and to be safer.

Infrared sauna harness should be utilized against overheating and against humidity.

We’re looking forward to providing you with necessary parts.
text_short: Infrared sauna wiring harness, also known as cable harness, is a complex set of wires and cables that transmit electric power and/or signals to sauna electronic equipment. Wires and cables are bonded together with cable lacing and ties, straps and sleeves, conduit, electrical tape or a combination of the above-listed bond materials. Infrared sauna harness is protected against overheat and humidity.
